svg.title: Commands, execution boundaries and budgets
svg.desc: Offline CLI commands route to validation, demo, analysis replay, qualification evaluation and legacy conformance. Application APIs own publication. RunBudget persists shared usage while BudgetMeter bounds each retrieval.
